collaboration.title: Your management system on better terms, in exchange for your story.
intro: The Collaborator Program is a special way of working with OBIN, designed for entrepreneurs and small trading companies that want to digitize their operation with a business management system (ERPNext) and guidance on improving their processes, but don't yet have the budget for a standard implementation.

In exchange for preferential terms —a discount and installment payments— the collaborator authorizes their project to be used as a public reference: a testimonial, a case study and portfolio material for OBIN.

note.title: It is not a free service.
note.description: It is a preferential-terms arrangement: you always cover part of the project, but on better terms than a standard implementation.

audience.title: This program is for you if:
items: You run a business that is actually operating (not a project still on paper).
Your purchasing, sales or inventory processes can be clearly digitized.
You are willing to make your business a public case: authorizing the use of your name, brand and testimonial.
You can make a partial payment (the program doesn't replace payment, it makes it more accessible).

steps.title: Seven steps, from first contact to your published case.

items.title: Initial contact
items.description: You tell us about your business and your needs.

items.title: Diagnostic
items.description: We analyze the size of your business and the complexity of your processes to define the project scope.

items.title: Collaboration proposal
items.description: We present the discount percentage and the installment plan that apply to your case.

items.title: Signing the agreement
items.description: We put in writing the project scope, the discount, the payment schedule and the authorization to use your case as a reference.

items.title: Implementation and training
items.description: We carry out the ERP project and process consulting as agreed.

items.title: Case documentation
items.description: Together we gather the metrics, the testimonial and the visual material from the project.

items.title: Publication
items.description: Your case becomes a reference in OBIN's portfolio and channels.

rows.includes: ERPNext implementation within the scope defined in the diagnostic.
rows.excludes: Custom development outside the agreed scope.

rows.includes: Mapping and improvement of the key processes defined in the diagnostic.
rows.excludes: Open-ended or unlimited consulting beyond the agreed processes.

rows.includes: Training for your team on how to use the system.
rows.excludes: Indefinite ongoing training, or training for new staff after the project closes.

rows.includes: A discount on the standard rate (defined case by case) and installment payments.
rows.excludes: A free service; part of the project is always covered by you.

rows.includes: Support during implementation and the stabilization period.

rows.excludes: Cost of licenses, hosting or third-party services.

asks.title: What we ask of you as a collaborator
items: Authorize the use of your name or brand, testimonial, screenshots and project metrics as a public case study.
Take part in documenting the case: an interview, a short video or a written testimonial.
Keep to the agreed installment plan.
Provide the information and availability needed during the diagnostic and implementation.

offers.title: What OBIN offers you
items: A serious diagnostic of your project before we offer you terms.
A transparent discount, justified by the analysis of your case.
A clear installment plan for implementation and training.
The same delivery quality as a fully paid project.
